research_notes: Pricing data sourced from company websites, G2, Capterra, Vendr, and third-party review sites. Custom-quoted prices estimated from buyer guides and community reports.

competitors.name: accessiBe

pricing.notes: Starter $490/yr (5K visits), Growth $1,490/yr (30K visits), Scale $3,990/yr (100K visits)

competitors.target_customer: SMB websites, non-technical owners wanting a fast 'compliance' fix
notable_issues: FTC $1M fine finalized April 2025 for deceptive compliance claims
Barred from claiming AI makes sites 'WCAG compliant'
22.6% of 2025 ADA lawsuits targeted overlay-equipped sites
National Federation of the Blind formally opposes the product
Courts consistently reject overlays as good-faith compliance efforts

competitors.name: UserWay
competitors.size: Acquired by Level Access Dec 2023 for $98.7M; ~118 employees, ~$13-42M revenue

pricing.notes: Small Plan $49/mo (100K page views), Medium Plan $149/mo (1M page views)

competitors.target_customer: SMB and mid-market websites; now being pushed toward Level Access enterprise clients
notable_issues: Acquired by Level Access in March 2024 - strategy shift underway
Shares same structural limitations as all overlay vendors
Widget-equipped sites still face lawsuits at high rates
strengths: Now backed by Level Access expertise
weaknesses: Same structural bypass limitations as accessiBe

competitors.name: AudioEye

pricing.notes: Basic (automated) starts ~$199/mo per domain; Self-Managed and Maximum Protection tiers require demo/quote. 4 pricing editions total.

competitors.target_customer: SMB to mid-market; claims to serve 120K+ customers across industries
notable_issues: Still relies partly on overlay approach despite hybrid claims
Higher price point than competitors but similar structural limitations
ADA lawsuits filed against AudioEye-equipped sites
strengths: Human auditor layer on top of automation
AudioEye Assurance limited legal protection claim
weaknesses: Overlay component doesn't fix source code

competitors.name: EqualWeb

pricing.notes: Free tier to tailored enterprise plans; claims $1M warranty on compliance

competitors.target_customer: SMB websites seeking hybrid AI + human model
notable_issues: $1M warranty claim is marketing language — no documented payouts
Overlay-based limitations still apply

competitors.name: Equally AI

pricing.notes: Pricing page exists but rates not publicly disclosed in research

competitors.target_customer: SMB websites wanting ADA/EAA/WCAG compliance signal
notable_issues: Early-stage company
Relatively unreviewed in independent sources

competitors.name: Deque Systems (axe)

pricing.notes: axe DevTools Pro starts ~$40/mo. Full audit services are custom-quoted. Free axe-core open-source library is industry standard.

competitors.target_customer: Enterprise, government, large organizations; developers via tooling
notable_issues: Named Forrester Wave Leader Q4 2025
axe-core powers most accessibility testing tools in the industry
strengths: axe-core is the underlying engine for most tools
weaknesses: Primarily a tool/platform company, not a 'done for you' service

competitors.name: Level Access
competitors.size: Private, $100M+ ARR, KKR-backed, ~500+ employees; acquired UserWay ($98.7M) and eSSENTIAL Accessibility

pricing.notes: Platform AMP starts $30K+/year per most buyer guides. Full managed services well into six figures.

competitors.target_customer: Enterprise Fortune 500, government agencies, large organizations
notable_issues: First digital accessibility company to surpass $100M ARR (announced Dec 2024)
KKR investment signals aggressive growth/acquisition strategy
Acquired UserWay to add SMB reach — but SMB is not the core focus
strengths: Only player at $100M+ ARR in pure-play accessibility
weaknesses: Priced out of SMB market entirely

competitors.name: TPGi (The Paciello Group)
competitors.size: Private, part of Vispero group, ~200 employees

pricing.notes: ARC Platform SaaS + professional services. TPGi as a Service (TaaS) new offering. No public SMB pricing.

notable_issues: 21 team members actively contributing to W3C standards
JAWS Inspect tool for screen reader simulation
Launched TaaS (TPGi as a Service) managed service model
strengths: Vispero group owns JAWS screen reader — unique testing advantage
weaknesses: Less brand recognition than Deque or Level Access outside enterprise

competitors.name: Allyant

pricing.notes: No public pricing; custom quotes in 2-3 business days. Services include audit, document remediation, website remediation, ongoing maintenance.

competitors.target_customer: Mid-market organizations needing full-service audit + remediation
notable_issues: No pricing transparency — cited as a weakness in TechRadar review
weaknesses: Limited online presence vs. Deque/Level Access

competitors.name: WebAIM

pricing.notes: WAVE browser extension is free. WAVE API starts at $10/mo for 100 credits. Limited commercial services.

notable_issues: Publishes annual WebAIM Million report — authoritative industry benchmark

competitors.name: Siteimprove
notable_issues: Broader platform: SEO + quality + accessibility + analytics bundle
weaknesses: Overkill for small professional services firms

competitors.name: Pope Tech

pricing.notes: Free (1-25 pages, 2 users). Team $25/mo annual (50-500 pages). Business Plus $225/mo annual (500+ pages). Professional $400/mo annual (training included).

competitors.target_customer: SMB and education — most affordable real monitoring platform
notable_issues: Monitoring tool only — does not do remediation
weaknesses: Requires technical team to fix issues found
Light customer support vs. enterprise tools

competitors.name: DubBot

pricing.notes: Custom pricing only. No public tiers. Education-focused.

notable_issues: Heavily education-focused — limited relevance outside edu
strengths: Strong reporting for decentralized content management
weaknesses: Not relevant for professional services SMBs

competitors.name: Silktide

pricing.notes: No public pricing. Custom quotes. Bundles accessibility + content quality + marketing metrics.

notable_issues: Strong Siteimprove alternative per multiple reviews
strengths: Unified platform for accessibility + content + SEO

competitors.name: axe DevTools Pro (Deque)

pricing.notes: Pro starts ~$40/mo per developer. Free open-source axe-core available. Enterprise pricing custom.

notable_issues: Powers testing in 90%+ of other accessibility tools
weaknesses: Does not fix issues, only finds them

competitors.name: Accessible.org

pricing.notes: $100-$250/page for primary pages. $25-$100 for lighter pages. VPAT $350+. User testing $550/session.

competitors.target_customer: Organizations needing transparent, itemized audit pricing
notable_issues: No longer offers remediation (deprecated service)
strengths: Only major player with fully public transparent pricing

full_rebuild_with_accessibility.notes: No competitor explicitly packages audit + rebuild as one SMB product
